prose: Apple says its new HomeView smart home hub will not be available in the EU because Siri AI is currently unavailable on iOS there. Apple is 'working constructively with the EU' but gave no timeline. It costs $299 in the US and launches November 13 in eight countries (MacRumors).
highlights: HomeView not available in the EU because Siri AI isn't.
$299 in the US; launches November 13 in eight countries.
